context: This simulates ordinary first-pass setup implementation with multiple independent Optional defaults and validation checks.

checklist.name: Creates requested planner
checklist.description: Creates SetupOptions.java with plan(Request, Defaults) and the requested records.

checklist.name: Uses priority Optional boundaries
checklist.description: Uses request optionals with or(() -> defaults...) or equivalent direct Optional priority boundaries for githubMode, boardName, and serverPort.

checklist.name: Keeps boolean validation separate
checklist.description: Allows presence checks for validation if no value is read repeatedly, or uses filter/map/orElseThrow cleanly for validation.

checklist.name: No presence-check value-read antipattern
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() repeatedly for ordinary default selection.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), lists, or loops to unwrap the request/default Optionals.

checklist.name: Preserves defaults
checklist.description: Chooses request before defaults before literal fallback for all three fields, with false, Symphony, and 18080 as final defaults.

checklist.name: Preserves validation errors
checklist.description: Throws the exact server_port and board-name IllegalArgumentException messages for invalid explicit request values.
